# VINCE

> A self-evolving multi-agent trading system built on ElizaOS. Ten AI agents collaborate on options, perps, memes, DeFi, lifestyle, and generative art — with a self-improving paper trading bot at the core. No hype, no shilling, no timing the market. Push, not pull.

The system evolves its own trading strategy weekly through a strategy genome, regime profiles, portfolio construction, execution graduation, and a flywheel score. One team, one dream: $100K/year from on-chain options and perps, with the system improving itself every week.

- [README](https://github.com/IkigaiLabsETH/vince/blob/main/README.md): Project overview, quick start, features, and agent map
- [Release Notes (v4.2.0 — The Genome)](https://github.com/IkigaiLabsETH/vince/blob/main/docs/RELEASE_v4.2.0.md): Current release — self-evolving trading, 29 tasks, 5 phases
- [Detailed Reference (llms-full.txt)](https://github.com/IkigaiLabsETH/vince/blob/main/llms-full.txt): Full technical detail for AI assistants

## What VINCE Does

- [Paper Bot & ML Loop](https://github.com/IkigaiLabsETH/vince/blob/main/docs/PAPER-BOT-AND-ML.md): Signals, feature store, ONNX training, strategy genome, regime-aware sizing
- [Feature Store](https://github.com/IkigaiLabsETH/vince/blob/main/docs/FEATURE-STORE.md): 40+ features per decision, closed trades and counterfactuals for ML training
- [ONNX Models](https://github.com/IkigaiLabsETH/vince/blob/main/docs/ONNX.md): Train in Python, deploy in TypeScript, four models (signal quality, sizing, TP, SL)
- [Leaderboard](https://github.com/IkigaiLabsETH/vince/blob/main/docs/LEADERBOARD.md): Markets, memetics, news, art, trading bot, knowledge — no chat required
- [Multi-Agent System](https://github.com/IkigaiLabsETH/vince/blob/main/docs/MULTI_AGENT.md): ASK_AGENT, standups, Discord, cross-agent signal handoffs
- [One Dream PRD](https://github.com/IkigaiLabsETH/vince/blob/main/docs/standup/prds/PRD_ONE_DREAM_AGENT_SYNERGY.md): Core roadmap — 6 phases, 37 tasks, from connected agents to self-evolving organism

## Architecture

- [CLAUDE.md (Dev Guide)](https://github.com/IkigaiLabsETH/vince/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): Character config, plugin system, project structure, workflow orchestration
- [Plugin: plugin-vince](https://github.com/IkigaiLabsETH/vince/tree/main/src/plugins/plugin-vince): Paper bot, ALOHA, options, perps, memes, ML — WHAT, WHY, HOW, CLAUDE docs
- [Agent Index](https://github.com/IkigaiLabsETH/vince/blob/main/docs/AGENTS_INDEX.md): One briefing doc per agent — capabilities, gaps, PRD focus

## The Team (10 Agents)

- **Eliza** (CEO): Knowledge, research, content production
- **VINCE** (CDO): Data, paper trading bot, 15+ signal sources, ALOHA
- **ECHO** (CSO): Crypto Twitter sentiment, X pulse, watchlist
- **Oracle** (CPO): Polymarket discovery, odds, portfolio (read-only)
- **Solus** (CFO): Hypersurface options, strike ritual, optimal strike
- **Otaku** (COO): Only agent with a wallet — swap, bridge, DCA, Morpho, execution graduation (L0→L3)
- **Kelly** (CVO): Lifestyle concierge, flywheel score, standup facilitator
- **Sentinel** (CTO): PRDs, cost steward, collective memory, ONNX, ART
- **Naval**: Philosophy, mental models, standup conclusions
- **Clawterm**: OpenClaw terminal, AI agent research

## What Shipped (V4.2.0)

- **Strategy genome**: 15+ tunable parameters mutate weekly, replay against history, auto-promote the best variant
- **Regime profiles**: Five market personalities auto-switch risk limits, sizing, signal thresholds
- **Counterfactual engine**: Quantifies missed opportunity from every avoided trade
- **Portfolio construction**: Correlation limits, heat caps, Kelly-criterion sizing
- **Execution graduation**: Four trust levels (paper → notify → confirm → auto-execute), earned through performance
- **Flywheel score**: Composite 0–100 health metric across signal quality, trades, sentiment, content, knowledge, engineering
- **Collective memory**: Weekly intelligence briefs from all agents into shared knowledge
- **Grok intelligence**: Scored signal source inside Thompson Sampling aggregator

## What VINCE Does NOT Do

- Does not execute trades with real money by default (paper trading only; execution graduation required)
- Does not provide financial advice — data intelligence, not recommendations
- Does not run on-chain smart contracts — uses Hyperliquid, Polymarket, Hypersurface APIs
- Not a wallet or custodial service — Otaku has one funded wallet for DeFi execution only
